product_repositories.rule: Pin and validate the central brand pack; do not redefine portfolio policy.

github.role: Canonical reviewable contracts, source token schemas, component API metadata, source SVGs, manifests, validators, and release evidence.

figma.role: Per-brand visual projection, component design, flow review, and design QA.
prohibited: re-publishing third-party reference kits as owned design
figma.next_gate: Commit a generated projection and provenance record, then validate a named desktop and mobile flow before components or library publishing.
required_pipeline: central brand pack plus local contract
observed: The existing FrankX workspace now has four deliberate one-mode collections, 60 local variables, 14 text styles, and five effect styles.
The bootstrap passed collection, mode, alias, scope, WEB code-syntax, and style-coverage validation.
Arcanea remains a separate overlay with no mutation in this execution.

canva.role: Brand Kits, locked content templates, decks, campaign variants, and reusable social production.
canva.next_gate: Create or validate Brand Kits only for active brands with an approved central brand pack.

google_drive.role: Working originals, legal and rights evidence, human-readable operating material, registrar evidence, and approved source material before DAM ingest.

central_dam.role: Approved shared media, provenance, derivatives, rights, usage tracking, and delivery references.
observed: A connected Cloudinary account contains a small FrankX namespace and a mostly sample/pilot inventory.
The account has not yet demonstrated an organisation-wide metadata, transformation, or delivery workflow.
requirements: asset IDs referenced from code and content manifests
central_dam.decision_gate: Keep Cloudinary as a pilot until it passes a single-brand metadata, approval, transformation, delivery, and usage-tracking proof. Do not migrate or run a second unmanaged library in parallel.
prohibited: public use before rights and approval metadata

vercel.role: Site delivery, real product proof captures, preview/production release evidence, and app-owned public assets.
observed: A connected Starlight Intelligence Vercel team serves multiple FrankX, Arcanea, Starlight, GenCreator, community, academy, and incubator projects.
vercel.blob_role: User uploads, generated exports, and private or ephemeral product files.

asset_flow: Working original and rights context in Google Drive
Register in the selected DAM plus asset-registry.json
Deliver via approved site media path or transformation
Record every live use in usedIn or an equivalent manifest

icon_policy.editorial_optional: Phosphor after license and style review
icon_policy.marks: Approved originals only; do not imitate or copy another brand's identity.

brand_enrollment.rule: A brand cannot claim design-system adoption until its central pack, local contract, and release evidence validate together.

prohibited: third-party reference kits published as owned components
